label: DEMO 1: Simple Technical Requirement (Induction Motor)
query: 15 kW three-phase squirrel-cage induction motor for industrial operation, 415 V, 50 Hz.
notes: Simple technical requirement: Extracts 15 kW, 415 V, 50 Hz, 3-phase ratings and recommends primary standard IS 12615:2018 with normative references.

label: DEMO 2: Semantic Understanding (Paraphrased Wording)
query: Industrial prime mover using a squirrel-cage rotor.
notes: Semantic vector superiority: Understands 'prime mover' and 'squirrel-cage rotor' despite absence of standard keywords in query, matching IS 12615:2018.

label: DEMO 3: Compound Procurement Requirement (3 Items)
query: Procure three-phase induction motors, low-voltage control panels with 415V busbars, and industrial safety helmets for factory workers.
notes: Multi-requirement segmentation: Automatically segments tender into 3 distinct items (Motors -> IS 12615, Control Panels -> IS/IEC 61439, Safety Helmets -> IS 2925).

label: DEMO 4: Standards Lifecycle (Superseded IS 325:1996)
notes: Lifecycle detection: Identifies obsolete IS 325:1996, generates prominent Superseded warning, and recommends replacement IS 12615:2018.

label: DEMO 5: Low-Confidence Rejection (Unknown Product)
query: Quantum warp propulsion system for spacecraft.
notes: Threshold enforcement: Detects out-of-catalog requirement, suppresses false recommendations, and clearly communicates that no relevant standard exists.

label: DEMO 6: Multi-Parameter Distribution Transformer
query: Outdoor oil immersed distribution transformer 250 kVA, 11 kV / 433 V, 50 Hz, 3-phase, with BEE 5-Star energy loss levels and mineral insulating oil.
notes: Validates exact technical ratings: 250 kVA, 11 kV, 433 V, BEE 5-star losses, and cross-links transformer oil standard IS 335:2018.

label: DEMO 7: Fly Ash Portland Pozzolana Cement (PPC)
query: Fly ash based Portland Pozzolana Cement (PPC) for reinforced concrete foundation and marine civil engineering works with compressive strength testing.
notes: Demonstrates pozzolana fly-ash matching, relations to IS 456 (concrete code) and IS 4031 (compressive strength testing).

label: DEMO 8: Earthquake Resistant TMT Steel Rebars Fe 500D
query: High strength thermo-mechanically treated TMT steel bars grade Fe 500D for earthquake resistant reinforced concrete structures with high ductility.
notes: Matches Fe 500D grade rebar, elongation and bend testing to IS 1608/IS 1599, and seismic detailing to IS 13920:2016.

label: DEMO 9: Industrial Safety Footwear & Impact Protection
query: Personal protective industrial safety footwear with 200 Joules impact resistant steel toe cap, oil and chemical resistant sole, and anti-static properties for factory personnel.
notes: Demonstrates PPE classification, 200J steel toe impact testing, slip resistance, and mandatory Scheme-I ISI mark under Footwear QCO.

label: DEMO 10: Utility Solar PV Modules & Grid Testing
query: Crystalline silicon solar photovoltaic (PV) modules 540 Wp for utility grid-connected power plant with design qualification, damp heat testing and safety qualification.
notes: Demonstrates Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS) flagging, relations to IS/IEC 61730 safety tests, and anti-islanding inverter codes.
